# truefoundry_remote_agent (Resource)

Manages a self-hosted agent registered on the TrueFoundry AI Gateway (`remote-agent/self-hosted` manifest) via `PUT /api/svc/v1/agents`. Every update creates a new immutable agent version on the control plane. TrueFoundry-hosted agents are managed with `truefoundry_agent`. Existing agents can be imported by their name, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_remote_agent.example my-agent`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A self-hosted A2A agent proxied through the AI Gateway.
resource "truefoundry_remote_agent" "billing" {
  name        = "billing-agent"
  description = "Self-hosted billing agent"
  url         = "https://agents.example.com/billing"

  framework = {
    type            = "a2a"
    agent_card_path = "/.well-known/agent.json"
  }

  auth = {
    type = "header"
    headers = {
      # A TrueFoundry secret reference; raw values work too but end up in state.
      "Authorization" = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::agents/billing/token"
    }
  }

  collaborators = [
    {
      subject = "team:everyone"
      role_id = "agent-access"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what the agent does.
- `framework` (Attributes) The protocol the self-hosted agent speaks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--framework))
- `name` (String) Name of the remote agent (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and single hyphens). Changing it replaces the agent.
- `url` (String) URL of the self-hosted agent endpoint, e.g. https://agents.example.com/my-agent.

### Optional

- `auth` (Attributes) How the gateway authenticates against the agent. Omitted means no authentication. `type` selects the mode; `headers` belongs to mode `header`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `collaborators` (Attributes Set) Subjects with a role on this agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collaborators))
- `tags` (Map of String) Free-form key-value tags on the agent.

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the agent, e.g. my-tenant:agent:my-agent.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the agent.

<a id="nestedatt--framework"></a>
### Nested Schema for `framework`

Required:

- `type` (String) Framework: `a2a` (Agent2Agent protocol) or `custom`.

Optional:

- `agent_card_path` (String) Path of the agent card relative to the URL, e.g. /.well-known/agent.json (type `a2a`).


<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Required:

- `type` (String) Authentication mode: `header` (static headers) or `passthrough` (forward the caller's credentials).

Optional:

- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent to the agent, e.g. {"Authorization" = "Bearer ..."} (type `header`). Values accept TrueFoundry secret references (recommended); the control plane returns them as stored, so drift is detected.


<a id="nestedatt--collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collaborators`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) Role to assign, e.g. agent-access or agent-manager.
- `subject` (String) Subject FQN, e.g. user:jane@example.com or team:everyone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Remote agents are imported by their name.
terraform import truefoundry_remote_agent.billing billing-agent
```
